name: com.uni-tx.store
description: A content-driven shop: each offer is an IAP (sold through UniIap, price from the store), a free claim on a cooldown (the repeat-visit loop), or a rewarded-video offer (granted only when the ad completes). Idempotent claims, entity-backed saves, and a backend seam for server authority.

samples.description: The whole shop lifecycle on a manual clock: claim a free offer, watch a rewarded offer, buy an IAP — with no provider installed the paid kinds degrade gracefully instead of throwing.

A uGUI shop: one scrollable feed with section headers, daily deals first and the free offer last, each row showing rewards, price and a claim button. Needs com.uni-tx.widgets and com.uni-tx.sprite-loader; without them the sample's assembly is skipped rather than breaking the project.
